LanguageData.CK_Shower.label: simple shower
LanguageData.CK_Shower.description: A 1x1 shower that can be placed anywhere. Needs water. Powered showers are hot; without power, a working water heater on the same network can still provide hot water. Otherwise it is a cold shower.
LanguageData.CK_ShowerPower.label: power shower
LanguageData.CK_ShowerPower.description: DBH power shower: heats water on demand, cleans twice as fast, uses more water.
